title: Vampire Vape Cherry Tobacco 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Cherry Tobacco Nic Salt pairs the earthy depth of Tobacco with the fruity lift of ripe Cherry. The Tobacco provides a solid, rich base, while Cherry introduces a bright edge of sweetness and gentle tartness for contrast. This e-liquid uses nicotine salts for faster absorption and a smoother throat hit. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s tailored for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping using pod kits, vape pens and starter devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Cherry Tobacco Nic Salt offers a distinctive flavour combination that balances tradition with fruit-forward appeal.
